title: Trait Objects as Pseudo-Enums
pattern: Using dynamic trait objects for a closed set of types known at compile time.
why_bad: Forces heap allocations and vtable lookup overhead, losing exhaustiveness checking.
detection: Storing `Box<dyn Trait>` where all implementers are inside the same module/crate and the set is closed.
fix: Replace dynamic dispatch with a rich `enum` and pattern matching.
